caption:
A lightning fighter battles a fire warrior.
Seedance 2.5 conjured that fire dragon from words.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 64 seconds · 4:3 aspect ratio · photorealistic live-action epic fantasy, ultra-detailed 4K, 35mm and 85mm cinema lenses, warm golden-hour grade with cool teal shadows, volumetric god rays through towering cumulus clouds, dense particle FX (fire embers, blue lightning arcs, water spray, flying turf and dust) · camera: kinetic, mixing slow-motion close-ups, handheld tracking, low FPV drone runs skimming the grass and huge aerial wides · pacing: fast-cut action trailer, 1-2 s shots in the fights, longer held wides for the dragon reveal, white flash frames on the big impacts.

CHARACTERS:
- LIGHTNING FIGHTER: lean athletic young man, about 20, pale skin tinted cold blue by his own energy, messy shaggy white-blond hair falling over his forehead, glowing white-blue eyes. Dark navy sleeveless hooded top with white drawstrings, very baggy dark navy martial-arts pants, barefoot. Signature in every shot: vivid blue-white lightning veins crawling over both forearms and fists and crackling around his bare feet.
- FIRE WARRIOR: tall muscular dark-skinned warrior, long wild black hair whipping in the wind, glowing red-orange eyes, glowing lava cracks across bare chest, arms and face; in the late close-ups his face glows demonic red with two small horns and jagged spikes along the shoulders. Bare-chested with crimson and maroon cloth wraps and a red sash, very wide black hakama-style pants, scabbard at the hip. Signature: a katana with a glowing orange-red blade and a round gold engraved guard, trailing fire.
LOCATION: a vast green glacial valley at golden hour: a calm shallow lake mirroring the sky, lush green meadows, steep green mountains with snow-dusted peaks, a braided river winding over sandy flats, one small green hill in the middle of the valley, huge dramatic clouds with sun rays. No buildings, no people besides the two fighters.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.3) — Over-the-shoulder from behind the lightning fighter standing shin-deep in the lake at frame right, lightning crackling down his arm; far across the water an orange fireball erupts on the surface.
SHOT 2 (00:00.3-00:00.9) — Quick closer insert on him, blue arcs running over his arm, the distant fire glowing on the water.
SHOT 3 (00:00.9-00:02.0) — Front close-up of his face: glowing white-blue eyes, blue-tinted skin, hair stirring in the wind, clouds behind; very slow push-in. White flash frame.
SHOT 4 (00:02.0-00:03.7) — A massive swirling orange fire blast sweeps across the frame left to right, past the lens; it clears into a wide: the fire warrior in the left foreground in shallow water whirls the flaming katana over his head, the lightning fighter stands in the lake at right, feet sparking, snow-dusted mountain behind. Flash cut.
SHOT 5 (00:03.8-00:05.7) — Slow-motion side close-up: the lightning fighter ducks his head as the burning katana slices horizontally just above his hair, gold round guard at frame left, flames streaming along the blade; his face lit orange by the fire, then cold blue as his lightning flares.
SHOT 6 (00:05.7-00:10.6) — Medium-wide, low over the lake: the fire warrior charges through the shallow water, a tall water geyser exploding behind him; the lightning fighter spins into a high side kick and his lightning-wrapped foot slams into the fire warrior's ribs in slow motion, blue arcs bursting, water spraying. Back to real speed: the fire warrior is blasted away across the lake as a tiny blurred figure, the camera whip-pans after him and settles on a calm wide of the lake reflecting the green slopes.
SHOT 7 (00:10.6-00:13.8) — Wide, then medium on the meadow: the fire warrior skids on one knee across the grass, ploughing a trench of torn turf, glowing sword trailing, a water geyser still falling in the distant lake. The lightning fighter rushes in and the fire warrior answers with a full circular slash. MUST SHOW: a glowing ring of fire tracing the blade's path around him.
SHOT 8 (00:13.8-00:18.6) — A large mossy boulder in the meadow glows blue from inside, then explodes into flying rocks and dust; the lightning fighter bursts out of the debris in a blue energy blur. Side-view medium-wide: the two clash, the fire warrior's vertical glowing sword against the lightning fighter's crackling fist, sparks and arcs between them, both leaning in hard.
SHOT 9 (00:18.6-00:19.2) — Rapid flash cuts of the clash.
SHOT 10 (00:19.2-00:22.1) — Low FPV drone run skimming the grass at high speed: a jagged blue lightning streak races ahead across the meadow toward the green hills and strikes a hillside, where an orange fire eruption bursts up.
SHOT 11 (00:22.1-00:24.2) — The hillside is engulfed in flames; a full-frame orange fireball rushes at the camera; the camera bursts through it into a wide of the meadow where a dark smoke column twists up from a small fire between the mountains.
SHOT 12 (00:24.2-00:25.6) — Close, low angle: the lightning fighter crouched low, lightning exploding off his body, the fire warrior raising the burning katana overhead above him.
SHOT 13 (00:25.6-00:26.2) — Rapid flash cuts.
SHOT 14 (00:26.2-00:27.0) — Extreme close motion blur: the lightning fighter rushes past the lens at the lake shore.
SHOT 15 (00:27.0-00:28.2) — From behind, he sprints across the shallow lake toward the fire warrior standing far away in the water, a blue lightning trail and spray behind him.
SHOT 16 (00:28.4-00:29.7) — Low FPV over the grass. MUST SHOW: a blue lightning stream and an orange fire stream racing side by side along the ground toward the mountains.
SHOT 17 (00:29.7-00:30.5) — Motion-blurred collision: the two slam together, a long horizontal red fire beam crossing the frame, lightning at his feet, dust exploding.
SHOT 18 (00:30.5-00:34.1) — Huge aerial wide, slow drift: the whole valley, green meadows, braided river and sandy flats, the small green hill, mountains under towering clouds with sun rays; two tiny sparks, one blue and one red, clash in the centre.
SHOT 19 (00:34.1-00:35.4) — Lower wide over the grass: a blue lightning glow at left and a red fire glow at right of a grassy mound, the fighters far apart.
SHOT 20 (00:35.4-00:41.1) — The dragon. Low-angle medium of the fire warrior by the lake, glowing katana held low at his side, lava cracks pulsing; the camera circles behind him as he turns, then cranes up and back into a locked-off wide. MUST SHOW: a colossal serpentine dragon made of roaring orange flame rises at frame right, its body coiling in a tall S-curve higher than the mountains, horned head with long whiskers and open jaws; the fire warrior tiny at its base right, the lightning fighter tiny with a blue glow at left, a scorched trench across the grass between them.
SHOT 21 (00:41.1-00:43.1) — Over-the-shoulder from behind the fire warrior, glowing blade pointed forward low, looking down the trench at the distant blue-glowing lightning fighter; a huge fire blast erupts across the meadow ahead.
SHOT 22 (00:43.1-00:45.8) — Tracking alongside: the lightning fighter dashes low and fast across the grass, leaning forward, lightning trailing from his feet, beside a roaring wall of dragon fire; the camera follows him into a tunnel of fire with radial motion blur; white flash frames flicker on the impacts.
SHOT 23 (00:45.8-00:49.1) — Side-view medium-wide on the meadow by the lake: lightning fist against the vertical glowing katana, sparks spraying; the dragon's flaming body arches across the sky behind them; they push against each other.
SHOT 24 (00:49.1-00:52.1) — Close two-shot face-off against a sky filled with fire: the lightning fighter at left seen from three-quarter behind, fists raised and wrapped in blue lightning; the fire warrior at right with his demonic glowing red face, small horns, spiked shoulders and lava cracks; the camera orbits slowly behind the lightning fighter's back.
SHOT 25 (00:52.1-00:58.1) — Wide: the lightning fighter lunges and the two slide through the shallow water in a burst of spray beneath the dragon's flaming body arching overhead like a canopy; they stop and circle each other in the shallow lake, a ring of ripples around them; the camera pulls back and rises as the dragon's head appears at the top of frame, its body curving around them.
SHOT 26 (00:58.1-01:00.9) — Front medium-wide. MUST SHOW: the dragon's giant glowing face with burning eyes looms directly behind them, its flaming body coiled in a full circle framing both fighters. The fire warrior raises the katana overhead with both hands, the dragon opens its jaws wide showing fangs, the lightning fighter leaps in with a lightning punch, water exploding up.
SHOT 27 (01:00.9-01:03.1) — Bright white flash, then a high aerial looking down at the lake shore. MUST SHOW: a huge circular shockwave ring of white dust and water spray expanding outward across the valley floor from the two tiny glowing figures (one blue, one red), a bright white flash between them; the ring keeps spreading and dust rolls over the grass.
SHOT 28 (01:03.1-01:04.2) — Final ground-level wide: a scorched, dusty flat; the two fighters stand far apart facing each other, blue glow at left, red glow at right, dust drifting, mountains and clouds behind. Hold.

SOUND: epic original orchestral score with pounding taiko-style drums and choir swells (instrumental, no vocals), building to the dragon reveal; crackling electric zaps, sword whooshes, roaring fire, water splashes, rock explosions, the dragon's deep roar, a massive boom on the final shockwave, then wind only on the last shot. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photorealistic 4:3 epic fantasy, golden hour in a green glacial valley. A white-haired lightning fighter battles a lava-cracked fire warrior with a flaming katana over a lake; a colossal fire dragon rises. FPV drone runs, slow-mo clashes, shockwave finale.
